title: Create a Flask Application With Google Login
description: Build a Python Flask app with Google login so users can sign in with their Google account, and learn OAuth 2, OpenID Connect, and Flask-Login.
summary: You’ve probably seen the option for Google Login on various websites. Some sites also have more options like Facebook Login or GitHub Login .
takeaways: Some sites also have more options like Facebook Login or GitHub Login .
This article will be more straightforward if you already understand the basics of Python .
All these options allow users to utilize existing accounts to use a new service.
